title: STEP D — ORC definition reconciliation matrix: unweighted-uniform (native exact) vs weighted GraphRicciCurvature, on the SAME committed FINAL graphs

graphs.note: All values below (native + weighted_GRC_on_FINAL) computed on the SAME committed *_edges_FINAL.csv files, LCC. The published_v6.4_weighted column is on an OLDER graph instance (see mixing_flags).

unweighted_uniform_native.spec: alpha=1/2 uniform lazy walk; UNWEIGHTED hop ground distance; kappa=1-W1 exact over Q (min-cost-flow). Edge weights IGNORED.
unweighted_uniform_native.source: Sounio native exact machinery (stdlib/ot/swow_orc.sio; swow_unified_orc.sio line 5: 'alpha=0.5 lazy random walk, hop-distance APSP, unweighted edges'). souc 6183636b.

weighted_GRC.spec: GraphRicciCurvature.OllivierRicci, alpha=0.5, edge weight = R1.Strength, undirected largest CC (code/analysis/compute_curvature_FINAL.py). Distances AND measures use edge weights.

evidence: submission/nature-communications-v2.0/...main.md line 76: 'We computed Ollivier-Ricci curvature using the GraphRicciCurvature Python library, preserving the directed and weighted nature of semantic associations ... alpha was set to 0.5 ... 100 Sinkhorn iterations ... largest weakly connected component.'
manuscript/supplement/S1_detailed_methods.md: GraphRicciCurvature 0.5.3 pinned; compute_curvature_FINAL.py is the curvature script.
data/processed/statistical_tests_v6.4.json (the committed 'published' kappa) is the WEIGHTED family (EN -0.197, ES -0.104, NL -0.172, ZH -0.189).
definition_used_by_preprint_and_deck.native_machinery_definition: UNWEIGHTED-uniform-hop (EN -0.137 family). This is a DIFFERENT estimator from the preprint's weighted GRC.

mixing_flags: FLAG-1 (definition fork): The Sounio native exact ORC (-0.137/-0.068/-0.144/-0.196) is UNWEIGHTED-uniform-hop; the preprint/deck report WEIGHTED GraphRicciCurvature (-0.197/-0.104/-0.172/-0.189). Citing a native -0.137 next to a manuscript -0.197 as if the same quantity is a category error: same edge, different ORC estimator.

FLAG-2 (stale graph instance): statistical_tests_v6.4.json was computed on an OLDER graph instance (n_values EN 811 / ES 776 / NL 816 / ZH 799) NOT equal to the current FINAL LCC edge counts (640/571/762/835). Re-running the SAME weighted GRC definition on the current committed FINAL files gives substantially different magnitudes (EN -0.258 vs -0.197; NL -0.270 vs -0.172). The weighted numbers in v6.4 should be regenerated on the committed FINAL files before publication.

FLAG-3 (manuscript internal drift): manuscript carries >=3 kappa value sets — v2.0 Table-1 prose (EN -0.258/ES -0.155/ZH -0.214 = weighted GRC on FINAL), v6.4 JSON (EN -0.197 family = weighted GRC on older graphs), v1.8 'overall -0.166'. These are the same definition on different graph snapshots; lock to one snapshot.

FLAG-4 (NL audit-ref is the UNWEIGHTED def): the prior audit gist e3a3072 NL reference (-0.196019) matches the NATIVE UNWEIGHTED value (-0.196029), NOT the manuscript weighted NL (-0.172/-0.270). The 'NL parity' anchor is therefore in the unweighted-uniform definition, while the manuscript headline is weighted. Do not cross-grade them.

recommendation.lock_to_one: Pick ONE definition + ONE graph snapshot for all published kappa.
recommendation.if_citing_native_exact_machinery: report UNWEIGHTED-uniform-hop: EN -0.137, ES -0.068, ZH -0.144, NL -0.196 (exact over Q, native-vs-oracle agree to <=1e-9).
recommendation.if_keeping_weighted_GRC_headline: regenerate ALL four on the committed FINAL files (EN -0.258, ES -0.155, ZH -0.214, NL -0.270) and retire the stale v6.4 -0.197 family; the native machinery does NOT compute this number.
recommendation.sign_robust: Either way the scientific claim 'all four SWOW association networks are hyperbolic (kappa_mean < 0)' holds under BOTH definitions and on BOTH graph snapshots.

DECISION_LOCKED_2026_06_04.decision: Headline/manuscript definition = WEIGHTED GraphRicciCurvature (alpha=0.5) on the committed FINAL graphs (EN -0.258, ES -0.155, ZH -0.214, NL -0.270). The native Sounio exact machinery = UNWEIGHTED-uniform-hop (EN -0.137, ES -0.068, ZH -0.144, NL -0.196) and is reported as an INDEPENDENT, exact-over-Q, Farkas-certified, Slurm-reproducible CONFIRMATION of the hyperbolic sign — not as the headline number.
DECISION_LOCKED_2026_06_04.why: Both definitions give kappa_mean < 0 for all four languages, so the scientific conclusion (semantic association networks are hyperbolic) is robust to the ORC definition. The manuscript already commits to weighted GRC throughout; the native machinery's value is the exact certification of the SIGN, which both definitions agree on.
DECISION_LOCKED_2026_06_04.do_not: Do NOT print the native unweighted -0.196 next to the weighted -0.270 as the same quantity (mixing flag #1). Do NOT cite the stale statistical_tests_v6.4.json -0.197 family (retired).
DECISION_LOCKED_2026_06_04.future_work_option_a: Extending the native exact machinery to a WEIGHTED ORC (weighted shortest-path ground distance + weight-proportional lazy-walk measure, exact min-cost-flow over Q with rational R1.Strength weights) would let the certified number MATCH the weighted headline. Substantial; NOT required for the sign claim. Tracked as future work.
